lines.text: John sent two of his disciples to ask Jesus whether He was the One who was to come.
Jesus healed many people, then told John's men to report that the blind receive sight and the good news is preached to the kings.
Jesus asked the crowds what they went out into the wilderness to see, and said John was more than a prophet.
The people and tax collectors acknowledged God's justice, but the Pharisees and experts in the law rejected God's purpose for themselves.
Jesus said people accused John of having a demon, and said the Son of Man was called a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of Pharisees.
